name: Maize Lethal Necrosis (MLN)
scientific_name: Maize chlorotic mottle virus + Sugarcane mosaic virus
key_signs_for_detection: Yellow chlorotic mottling from leaf base; leaf margins dry from tip ('dead heart'); premature plant death; small poorly filled cobs
favourable_conditions: Continuous maize cropping; high thrips and aphid vector numbers; dry spells
prevention: Plant MLN-tolerant certified seed; observe maize-free period; rotate with legumes; control thrips/aphids early
organic_cultural_control: Uproot and destroy infected plants; rotate 1-2 seasons with beans/potatoes/cassava; weed grass hosts
chemical_control: No cure. Vector control only: imidacloprid or thiamethoxam seed dressing; lambda-cyhalothrin for thrips. Use only PCPB-registered products; follow label rate and pre-harvest interval (PHI); wear PPE; rotate modes of action.
expert_vet_advice: Report outbreaks to county agriculture officer/KALRO
kenya_regions: Rift Valley, Western, Nyanza, Central, Eastern
reference_sources: KALRO; CABI PlantwisePlus factsheets; FAO; Infonet-Biovision

name: Northern Leaf Blight (Turcicum)

prevention: Resistant hybrids; crop rotation; bury residues
organic_cultural_control: Remove lower infected leaves; rotate with non-cereals; deep ploughing of residues
chemical_control: Azoxystrobin, propiconazole or mancozeb at first lesions on susceptible varieties. Use only PCPB-registered products; follow label rate and pre-harvest interval (PHI); wear PPE; rotate modes of action.
kenya_regions: Highlands of Rift Valley, Western, Central
reference_sources: KALRO; CABI PlantwisePlus factsheets; FAO; Infonet-Biovision

name: Maize Ear Rot

organic_cultural_control: Sort and destroy mouldy cobs; dry on tarpaulins; hermetic storage bags; Aflasafe KE01 biocontrol
chemical_control: No curative spray; prevention only. Use only PCPB-registered products; follow label rate and pre-harvest interval (PHI); wear PPE; rotate modes of action.

prevention: Clean dry udder; strip cup/CMT checks; teat dip after milking; dry cow therapy; milk infected cows last
chemical_control: Intramammary antibiotic tubes. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Trypanosomiasis (Nagana)

key_signs_for_detection: Progressive weight loss, anaemia, intermittent fever, lacrimation, poor fertility
prevention: Tsetse targets/traps; insecticide-treated cattle; prophylactic drugs
chemical_control: Isometamidium (prophylaxis), diminazene (treatment). Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
kenya_regions: Coast (Kwale, Kilifi, Lamu), Lake Victoria basin, Rift
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Anthrax
key_signs_for_detection: Sudden death; dark tarry blood from nose, mouth and anus that does not clot; no rigor mortis
favourable_conditions: Dry season after rains; contaminated soils
organic_cultural_control: Do NOT open carcass; bury deep with lime or burn
chemical_control: Treatment rarely possible. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
expert_vet_advice: Notifiable: zoonotic - never eat meat from sudden deaths; call vet
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Blackquarter
key_signs_for_detection: Lameness; crackling gas swelling on thigh/shoulder; rapid death
favourable_conditions: Wet season, grazing on disturbed soil
chemical_control: Penicillin early. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Contagious Bovine Pleuropneumonia (CBPP)
key_signs_for_detection: Cough, laboured breathing, extended head and neck, fever
chemical_control: Treatment discouraged (carriers). Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Brucellosis
key_signs_for_detection: Abortion in last third of pregnancy; retained placenta; swollen joints/testicles
prevention: Vaccination of heifers (S19); boil milk; gloves at birth
chemical_control: No treatment in animals. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Rift Valley Fever
key_signs_for_detection: Mass abortions; high death of young lambs/kids; fever, bloody diarrhoea
prevention: Vaccinate before predicted heavy rains; mosquito control
chemical_control: No treatment. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Newcastle Disease
key_signs_for_detection: Gasping, twisted neck, paralysis, green watery diarrhoea, sudden deaths, drop in eggs
favourable_conditions: Unvaccinated flocks; dry season; bird movement

chemical_control: No cure. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Gumboro (Infectious Bursal Disease)

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

prevention: Buy from certified hatcheries; biosecurity; vaccination
chemical_control: Antibiotics per lab sensitivity. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Coccidiosis (Poultry)
key_signs_for_detection: Bloody droppings, huddling, ruffled feathers, deaths in chicks
prevention: Dry litter; coccidiostat in starter feed
chemical_control: Amprolium or toltrazuril in water. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Fowl Pox
key_signs_for_detection: Wart-like scabs on comb, wattles, eyelids; yellow plaques in mouth
chemical_control: Antibiotics for secondary infection. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

key_signs_for_detection: Leg paralysis with one leg forward one back; grey eye; tumours

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Infectious Coryza

chemical_control: Sulphonamides or antibiotics. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

key_signs_for_detection: Fever, eye and nose discharge, mouth sores, severe diarrhoea, pneumonia, high deaths
chemical_control: No cure; supportive care. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Contagious Caprine Pleuropneumonia (CCPP)

chemical_control: Antibiotic spray for secondary infection. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Sheep and Goat Pox
key_signs_for_detection: Fever, skin nodules and scabs on hairless areas
chemical_control: Supportive. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: African Swine Fever
key_signs_for_detection: High fever, red/purple skin on ears and belly, bloody diarrhoea, sudden death of many pigs
favourable_conditions: Feeding swill; free-range pigs; ticks; pig movements
prevention: Strict biosecurity; no swill feeding; confine pigs
organic_cultural_control: Cull and dispose under vet supervision
chemical_control: No vaccine or cure.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Rabies
affects: Dogs, cats, cattle, all mammals, humans
key_signs_for_detection: Behaviour change, aggression or dullness, drooling, difficulty swallowing, paralysis
prevention: Annual vaccination of dogs and cats
chemical_control: No treatment for animals once signs appear.
expert_vet_advice: Notifiable: humans bitten need urgent post-exposure vaccine at hospital
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Bloat

prevention: Introduce lush pasture gradually; feed hay first
organic_cultural_control: Walk animal; cooking oil drench for frothy bloat
chemical_control: Anti-bloat drench (poloxalene). Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Pneumonia / Pasteurellosis

chemical_control: Antibiotics (oxytetracycline). Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Footrot
key_signs_for_detection: Lameness; foul-smelling rot between claws
organic_cultural_control: Footbath with zinc or copper sulphate
chemical_control: Antibiotics for severe cases. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Calf Scours
key_signs_for_detection: Watery yellow-white diarrhoea, dehydration (sunken eyes)
prevention: Colostrum within 6 h of birth; clean pens
organic_cultural_control: Oral rehydration salts; keep feeding milk

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Brown Ear Tick

chemical_control: Acaricides: amitraz, pyrethroids (deltamethrin, cypermethrin), organophosphates; pour-ons. Rotate classes. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Blue Tick

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Bont Tick
key_signs_for_detection: Large ornate ticks with coloured shields and long mouthparts, on udder, scrotum, armpits; abscesses
prevention: Spraying; tail-dip; spot treatment of udder/feet
chemical_control: Acaricides including pour-ons. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Fowl Tick
key_signs_for_detection: Hides in cracks by day; birds anaemic and weak, paralysis
chemical_control: Registered pyrethroid spray to houses (birds removed). Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Tsetse Fly
key_signs_for_detection: Brown flies with folded overlapping wings at rest; biting by day
prevention: Insecticide-treated targets and traps; insecticide-treated cattle
organic_cultural_control: Bush clearing near homesteads; avoid tsetse belts
chemical_control: Pour-on pyrethroids on legs and belly. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Stable Fly
key_signs_for_detection: Biting flies on legs; animals stamping; milk drop
prevention: Remove wet feed and manure every week
chemical_control: Pyrethroid sprays. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Mange Mites
affects: Pigs, goats, dogs, cattle, camels, rabbits
key_signs_for_detection: Intense itching, hair loss, thick crusty or wrinkled skin
chemical_control: Ivermectin injection or amitraz wash. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Lice (Livestock)

key_signs_for_detection: Animals rubbing; patchy hair loss; visible lice and eggs on hair

key_signs_for_detection: Tiny red/grey mites in cracks and perches at night; anaemia, pale comb, egg drop
prevention: Clean and lime-wash houses; seal cracks
chemical_control: Registered acaricide on housing. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Scaly Leg Mite
key_signs_for_detection: Raised crusty scales on legs
organic_cultural_control: Dip legs in vegetable oil/paraffin weekly
chemical_control: Ivermectin. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Stick-tight Flea
key_signs_for_detection: Dark fleas attached in clusters around eyes, comb and wattles
chemical_control: Permethrin dust. Drugs and vaccines through a registered vet or animal health assistant; observe milk/meat withdrawal periods.
reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Jiggers
key_signs_for_detection: Swollen sores on feet with black central dot

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Poultry Roundworms

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

name: Tapeworms

reference_sources: Kenya Directorate of Veterinary Services; WOAH (OIE); FAO; ILRI; Infonet-Biovision

suitable_crops_or_soils: Coffee, tea, maize, beans, bananas, avocado, macadamia, dairy fodder
soil_management: Lime if pH below 5.5; DAP/TSP for phosphorus fixation; terraces on slopes; manure
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Andosol (Young Volcanic)
key_signs_for_detection: Dark, very light and fluffy soil with high organic matter
texture_drainage: Silty loam; very well drained, high water holding
suitable_crops_or_soils: Potatoes, pyrethrum, tea, wheat, cabbage, carrots, peas
soil_management: Phosphate fertilisers; lime acid patches; erosion control
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Black Cotton Soil (Vertisol)
key_signs_for_detection: Black/dark grey heavy clay; deep cracks when dry; sticky when wet
suitable_crops_or_soils: Rice (paddy), cotton, sorghum, chickpea, wheat, sugarcane, Rhodes grass
soil_management: Plough at right moisture; raised/camber beds; drainage channels; add organic matter
kenya_regions: Kano plains, Athi plains, Ahero, Narok, parts of Kilifi hinterland
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Coastal Sandy Soil (Arenosol)
key_signs_for_detection: Loose pale to reddish sand; water drains instantly; low organic matter
texture_drainage: Sand to loamy sand; excessively drained
suitable_crops_or_soils: Coconut, cashew, cassava, mango, groundnut, sesame, watermelon, pigeon pea, Bixa
soil_management: Heavy manure/compost; mulch; split fertiliser applications; drip irrigation; zai pits
kenya_regions: Kilifi, Malindi, Kwale, Lamu coastal plain
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Ferralsol (Deep Weathered Red/Yellow)
key_signs_for_detection: Deep red or yellow, very uniform, weak structure, low fertility
suitable_crops_or_soils: Cassava, cashew, pineapple, tea, coconut, mango, sweet potato
soil_management: Lime; organic matter; rock phosphate; legumes in rotation
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Acrisol
key_signs_for_detection: Reddish or yellowish soil with clay-rich subsoil; acidic
texture_drainage: Sandy loam over clay; moderately well drained
suitable_crops_or_soils: Tea, cassava, pineapple, cashew, sweet potato
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Luvisol
key_signs_for_detection: Brown soil with clay-enriched subsoil; fairly fertile
texture_drainage: Loam over clay loam; well drained
suitable_crops_or_soils: Maize, beans, sorghum, cotton, sunflower, citrus, pastures
kenya_regions: Machakos, Makueni, Laikipia, parts of Coast
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Cambisol
key_signs_for_detection: Young brown soil with moderate development
soil_management: Organic matter; erosion control on slopes
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Alluvial Soil (Fluvisol)
key_signs_for_detection: Layered silt/sand deposits along rivers; dark and fertile
suitable_crops_or_soils: Rice, bananas, sugarcane, vegetables, maize, onions, watermelon
kenya_regions: Tana River, Sabaki/Galana floodplains, Nzoia, Yala
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Planosol
key_signs_for_detection: Light-coloured topsoil over dense clay pan; perches water
texture_drainage: Sandy loam over clay; poorly drained
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Saline-Sodic Soil (Solonetz/Solonchak)
key_signs_for_detection: White salt crust on surface or dark dispersed hard soil; poor germination
suitable_crops_or_soils: Salt-tolerant: date palm, barley, cotton, sorghum, Rhodes grass, saltbush
soil_management: Gypsum application; leaching with good water; drainage; avoid salty irrigation water
kenya_regions: Arid lowlands, Magadi, parts of Coast irrigation areas
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Gleysol (Waterlogged)
key_signs_for_detection: Grey/blue-green mottled soil with rusty spots; waterlogged smell
suitable_crops_or_soils: Rice, arrowroots (nduma), sugarcane with drainage, fish ponds
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Calcisol (Calcareous)
key_signs_for_detection: Light-coloured soil with white lime nodules; fizzes with acid
suitable_crops_or_soils: Sorghum, millet, green grams, cowpeas, sisal, date palm, drought-tolerant pastures
soil_management: Organic matter; acidifying fertilisers (ammonium sulphate); micronutrient (Zn, Fe) foliar
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Leptosol (Shallow Rocky)
key_signs_for_detection: Very shallow soil over rock or murram; many stones
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Histosol (Peat/Organic)
key_signs_for_detection: Black spongy organic soil in swamps
soil_management: Lime; careful drainage (subsidence risk); protect wetlands
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Sandy Soil
key_signs_for_detection: Gritty; does not form a ball when moist; light colour
texture_drainage: Sand; very fast drainage, low water holding
suitable_crops_or_soils: Cassava, groundnut, watermelon, sweet potato, cashew, coconut, carrots
soil_management: Add compost/manure; mulch; frequent light irrigation
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Sandy Loam
key_signs_for_detection: Gritty but forms a weak ball
suitable_crops_or_soils: Tomato, onions, groundnut, maize, cowpea, mango, citrus, pawpaw
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Loam
key_signs_for_detection: Soft, crumbly; forms a ball that breaks easily
texture_drainage: Loam; well drained, good water holding
suitable_crops_or_soils: Most crops: maize, beans, vegetables, bananas, fruit trees
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Silt Loam
key_signs_for_detection: Smooth floury feel when dry, silky when moist
soil_management: Mulch to prevent crusting; cover crops
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Clay Loam
key_signs_for_detection: Sticky; forms ribbon 2.5-5 cm
texture_drainage: Clay loam; moderate to slow drainage
suitable_crops_or_soils: Coffee, bananas, maize, beans, cabbage, Napier grass
soil_management: Add organic matter; avoid working when wet
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Clay Soil
key_signs_for_detection: Very sticky; long ribbon over 5 cm; cracks when dry
suitable_crops_or_soils: Rice, sugarcane, cabbage, kale, beans (with drainage)
soil_management: Raised beds; organic matter; gypsum for structure
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop

name: Murram / Laterite
key_signs_for_detection: Red-brown gravelly hard layer; ironstone nodules
soil_management: Planting holes filled with topsoil + manure; zai pits; mulching
reference_sources: KALRO-KSS Kenya Soil Survey; FAO World Reference Base; FAO Ecocrop
